title: Associate DevOps Engineer
text:
Banyan Cloudworks manages infrastructure for clients ranging from C-suite analytics teams to R&D labs.

Must have: Linux administration, Bash scripting, Docker
Must have: CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
Must have: one cloud provider (AWS or Azure)
Good to have: Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring
Good to have: basic networking (DNS, load balancers, subnets)

Day to day
- Automate deployments and keep pipelines green
- Respond to alerts and write post-incident notes
